messages.subject: Optimizing the data frame
parts:
Hi Saptarishii,

Is there any wat to optimize the data frame? I mean to say i have 1 GB
file and i have written map reduce job to create key value pairs.

Now I have written another map reduce job where i aggregate all the
values into a single data frame.
That mean i have only single key and the value will be the entire data
frame.

1. If i run this above job, it takes lot of time.
2. If i read the output file using rhread, deserializing takes lot of
time.

Is there anyway to optimize this problem?


Regards,
Shekhar

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Optimizing the data frame
parts:
You placed all the contents of the 1GB file into one data frame?

1. It will take a lot of time.
2. the deserialize should not even work. RHIPE doesn't deserialize
values large than 256MB.
So how is it even deserializing your single key-value pair?

In a map-reduce style of working, it best to store your data as small
chunks and work across chunks.

Saptarshi

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: Optimizing the data frame
parts:
rather, you can store different values with the same key - they will
go the same file.
However, they appear as distinct key-value pairs.

You can also store the keys as c(id,1), c(id,2), ,...., c(id,N) which
may or may not go the same file.
You can control the file they go to using the part argument, e.g.
part=list(lims=1,type='string')
will send all key-values with the same key[1] component to the same
reducer (cannot use map file anymore)

See the manual

Regards
Saptarshi
